qualifier: classes A, B, F and H
name: Scavenger receptor ligand clearance by classes A, B, F, H
rationale: All four members are scavenging by a specific scavenger receptor class, whereas confusables are monocyte/myeloid identity, chemotaxis and inflammatory modules lacking the receptor-class scavenging steps.

qualifier: toward cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones
name: Mevalonate isoprenoid synthesis of cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K
rationale: Members span the mevalonate/isoprenoid route (IPP, FPP, GGPP) to sterols (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell) and prenylated quinones (ubiquinol, menaquinone/vitamin K), distinguishing it from bile-acid/cholesterol catabolism, dolichol synthesis and peroxisomal fatty acid confusables.

qualifier: distal branching, saccular stage and pneumocyte differentiation
name: Distal lung branching, saccule and pneumocyte development
rationale: All members are lung morphogenesis and growth events (branching, lobes, vasculature, saccules, type I/II pneumocytes, perinatal ductus closure), unlike confusables centred on trachea, surfactant metabolism or lung mesenchyme.

qualifier: selenium detoxification and molybdenum/PLP cofactor synthesis
name: Selenium detoxification, sulfide oxidation and MoCo/PLP cofactor synthesis
rationale: Members cover ingested selenium compound metabolism and methylation, hydrogen sulfide oxidation, cysteine catabolism and prosthetic cofactors (molybdenum cofactor, pyridoxal phosphate), whereas confusables centre on transsulfuration, glutathione and choline/carnitine metabolism.

qualifier: sleep-wake regulation, orexin and opioid receptors
name: Neuropeptide and opioid signaling regulating sleep-wake behavior
rationale: Members share neuropeptide/opioid G-protein signaling, dense-core vesicle release and nerve impulse modulation tied to sleep-wake states and behavior, distinguishing it from confusables about mating, aggression and CRH/corticosterone stress responses.

qualifier: FcεRI signaling and hypersensitivity reactions
name: FcεRI-mediated mast cell activation and hypersensitivity reactions
rationale: Members are FcεRI signaling, mast cell degranulation/histamine/cytokine output and hypersensitivity types, unlike Th2/eosinophil cytokine confusables and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

qualifier: olfactory receptors and sour taste
name: Olfactory and sour-taste chemosensory perception
rationale: Members are smell, odorant/pheromone response, olfactory receptor expression and sour taste detection, distinguishing them from sweet/bitter/umami/salty taste, acid-sensing channel and nose development confusables.

qualifier: plasma membrane iron import and cellular iron response
name: Iron ion import and systemic iron homeostasis
rationale: All four members concern free iron ion transport into cells, its regulation and organismal iron balance, unlike heme biosynthesis, transferrin cycling, oxygen transport and host-pathogen nutrient confusables.

qualifier: potassium channel-driven repolarization phases 1-4
name: Cardiac action potential repolarization by potassium channels
rationale: Members are action potential phases 1-4, atrial/ventricular repolarization and the Kv, Kir and TWIK potassium channels that drive it, whereas confusables emphasize phase 0 depolarization, conduction system signaling or other K2P/Ca-activated channels.

qualifier: pro-apoptotic and p21/G1 arrest target genes
name: p53 transcriptional activation of apoptosis and p21-mediated G1 arrest
rationale: Members cover TP53 expression, cofactors and its transcription of death receptors, caspases, cytochrome c release genes and p21/G1 arrest genes with positive regulation of p53 apoptosis, unlike confusables on negative regulation, ARF/INK4A senescence evasion or G2/DNA repair.

qualifier: ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO cues acting via Rho GTPases
name: Ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance signaling via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are ephrin/EPH, netrin/DCC and SLIT/ROBO signaling with RAC/CDC42/RHOA regulation, distinguishing it from semaphorin-plexin, L1/CHL1/DSCAM and commissural midline confusables.

qualifier: preintegration complex nuclear import and integration
name: HIV-1 preintegration complex nuclear import and integration
rationale: Members are post-reverse-transcription HIV-1 steps (Vpr-mediated PIC import, integration, 2-LTR and autointegration circles) plus APOBEC3G restriction, unlike confusables covering HIV entry and reverse transcription, HCMV or endogenous retroelements.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib self-recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity controlled by KIR/MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK degranulation and granzyme killing, protection from NK killing, KIR genes and MHC class Ib presentation and tolerance, whereas confusables emphasize NK activation, cytokine production and generic NK/T cell signatures.

qualifier: lysine and proline hydroxylation and methylation
name: Peptidyl lysine and proline hydroxylation and methylation
rationale: All members are protein side-chain hydroxylation or methylation of lysine/proline, distinguishing them from RNA modification, translation-factor modification (hypusine, diphthamide) and mono/dimethylation confusables.

qualifier: influenza and respiratory syncytial virus
name: Influenza and RSV negative-strand RNA virus replication cycle
rationale: Members cover influenza vRNP import, synthesis, export and host-evasion steps plus RSV transcription, replication and assembly, unlike coronavirus, HIV and HCMV confusables.

qualifier: cell adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 proliferation
name: Stromal fibroblast adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 proliferation
rationale: Members share a fibroblast/stromal program of cell adhesion, ECM/laminin and fibroblast proliferation with KRAS and FOSL targets, distinguishing it from pure ECM modules, YAP/TGF-beta mechanoresponsive and endothelial/secretory stromal confusables.

qualifier: uniporter EMRE (SMDT1) processing
name: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter-mediated calcium import
rationale: All three members concern calcium entry into mitochondria via the uniporter and its SMDT1 subunit, unlike mitochondrial protein import, processing and cristae confusables.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, interferons and IL-15/21 in NK/NKT cells
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, interferon and IL-15/21 signaling to NK/NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, type I/III interferon and IL-15/21 signaling with NK/NKT proliferation and activation, unlike IL-17/IL-33/IL-1 family, type 2/common gamma-chain and NF-kB activation confusables.

qualifier: reelin signaling and postsynaptic actin remodeling
name: Reelin-regulated dendrite arborization and postsynaptic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members cover reelin signaling, dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis and maintenance and postsynaptic actin/structure in plasticity, unlike synaptic adhesion/assembly, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase polarity confusables.

qualifier: cardiac electrical conduction and calcium handling
name: Cardiac electrical conduction and calcium-handling excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases and channels, conduction system and gap junctions, heart rate and SR/store-operated calcium handling controlling contraction, unlike cAMP/adrenergic, K2P ion homeostasis, hypertrophy and myofibril confusables.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics and PKR signaling
name: Stress granule dynamics, PKR signaling and proteasomal turnover regulation
rationale: Members combine regulation of proteasomal degradation and protein destabilization with stress granule assembly/disassembly and PKR signaling, which distinguishes it from deubiquitinase, ribosome quality control and PML/arsenite confusables.

qualifier: cadherin and tight junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
name: Epithelial cell-cell junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
rationale: Members are adherens, tight, desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions, cadherin adhesion, apical-basal polarity, barrier function and EMT, unlike basement membrane/integrin, mechanosensing, cornified envelope and Rho GTPase migration confusables.

qualifier: MTF1-induced metallothionein metal binding
name: Zinc-responsive MTF1-metallothionein metal buffering
rationale: All three members are the zinc-sensing MTF1 transcriptional response and metallothionein metal binding, unlike ROS detoxification and cadmium/heavy-metal response confusables.

core: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly
qualifier: chylomicron and VLDL assembly
name: Dietary lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members are dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption, acylglycerol transport and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, unlike bile acid, lipoprotein remodeling and clearance confusables.

qualifier: IRF3/7 activation, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3/7 and necroptosis in HSE
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking and TRIF/TICAM1-dependent TBK1-IRF3/7 activation and programmed cell death, with HSE-causing deficiencies, unlike MyD88/IRAK TLR7/8/9, TRIF-TAK1/IKK and RIPK1 necrosis confusables.
